'''Alclad alloy''' was a substance that was used in the construction of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|vulture droid]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. The fighters were plated in a light, non-magnetic alclad alloy.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />
